steps.clue: Defeat the Doppelghast and use its Blood Aetherium Crystal to unlock Pack-a-Punch.
Speak with Krafft and claim the four Bastard Swords using Stamps.
Upgrade the four swords, obtain their incantations, and complete the torn-page puzzle.
Honour the knight statues with their matching swords and incantations in the displayed order.
Complete the four elemental Mystic Orb challenges.
Place the charged Mystic Orb in the animal-symbol wall and recover the Guardian Key.
Place the key beneath the Town Square statue and defeat the Guardian.
